hints.text: The IQR is the difference between the upper quartile and the lower quartile, so you need both quartiles.
The lower half $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$ gives $Q_1 = 2.5$ and the upper half $\{5, 6, 7, 8\}$ gives $Q_3 = 6.5$. Subtract the first from the second.
$6.5 - 2.5 = 4$, so the IQR of the set is $4$.

explanation: Split the $8$ ordered values into the lower half $\{1, 2, 3, 4\}$ and the upper half $\{5, 6, 7, 8\}$.
The median of the lower half is $Q_1 = (2 + 3) \div 2 = 2.5$.
The median of the upper half is $Q_3 = (6 + 7) \div 2 = 6.5$.
The IQR is the distance between the quartiles: $6.5 - 2.5 = 4$.
